title: 黄仁勋回归：两周内不会变，交易风格收敛？
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: How do you see Jensen Huang coming back as Nvidia CEO? I mean, we just had Catherine say this might not be the same Jensen Huang anymore.
segments.zh: 你如何看待黄仁勋回归英伟达CEO？凯瑟琳刚说这可能不再是同一个黄仁勋了。

segments.en: He might not be as forthcoming or, you know, you know, I guess robust when it comes to the circular financing that has built this whole AI ecosystem.
segments.zh: 他可能不再那么坦率，或者说，在构建整个AI生态的循环融资方面，可能不再那么强势。

segments.en: Did you share that sort of view?
I think what we're gonna see is perhaps it's less freewheeling and dealing than we've seen in the past, but he was definitely a market maker.
segments.zh: 我认为我们可能会看到，他不再像过去那样自由随意地交易，但他绝对是一个市场推动者。

segments.en: And I think the assumption is that he'll still find a way to be a market maker and that it might look like a broader ecosystem play now.
segments.zh: 我认为假设是他仍会找到成为市场推动者的方式，而现在可能看起来像更广泛的生态布局。

segments.en: But I don't believe that, you know, within less than two weeks, there's a fundamental change in the individual or in the strategies or in what he thinks
segments.zh: 但我不相信在不到两周内，个人、策略或他认为的好生意想法会发生根本性变化。

segments.en: would make for good business, which is one of the reasons why they brought him back.
segments.zh: 这也是他们请他回来的原因之一。

segments.en: There was a tremendous discussion in the industry of who else would be able to do the same type of, not just technology, but the same type of deal making.
segments.zh: 业界曾热烈讨论还有谁能做同样类型的交易，不仅是技术，还有交易本身。

segments.en: It's actually a very expansive portfolio that he's built in terms of what he delivered to the business.
segments.zh: 他为公司带来的实际上是一个非常广泛的产品组合。

segments.en: So that I think doesn't necessarily change.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这不一定改变。

segments.en: People still want that to exist, but they want us some things to look a little more tuned down and a little more sanitized for the market at large.
segments.zh: 人们仍希望它存在，但希望某些方面更低调、更符合大众市场。
